buildCommand: wget -q https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.32.2-stable.tar.xz -O /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar xf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C $HOME && export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin && flutter config --no-analytics --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --base-href /
